parameters.content:
## Studio OS v2

Sheets: Projects (8 cols), Team, Equipment (+ Date_Needed_Until), Technician

Actions:
- Create → project + devices + technician row
- Update → build/video links + status
- Release → clear equipment reservation

Auto-release every 30m when Date_Needed_Until passed

parameters.formDescription: Create projects, submit build/video links, or release equipment.
Deadline only (no start date). Next page: developer, devices, technician.
Pick developer, optional technician/install date, and devices.

parameters.jsCode: const rows=$('Process Create Logic').first().json.equipment_rows||[]; if(!rows.length) return [{json:{_skip:true}}]; return rows.map(r=>({json:r}));
const rows=$('Process Create Logic').first().json.team_rows||[]; if(!rows.length) return [{json:{_skip:true}}]; return rows.map(r=>({json:r}));
const rows=$('Process Create Logic').first().json.technician_rows||[]; if(!rows.length) return [{json:{_skip:true}}]; return rows.map(r=>({json:r}));
